summary: Round 4 of 4 independent adversarial reviews (fresh context, read-only, unprimed) over the full diff. Verdict: no high or critical correctness defects. Reviewer independently verified all 7 DISTINCT ON keys are the leftmost ORDER BY prefix, placeholder alignment including the interpolated WHERE, DeduplicateByTMDBID end to end incl. the semantic.go swapped-pointer contract, completeness across internal/ cmd/ and the SPA, and the inert-by-construction claims for the two episode-file predicates (chasing ManualMatch/EnrichByTMDBID as the one path that could have falsified them). It applied 24 mutations, all killed. Findings: 1 medium (GetRecentMedia's two tests rely on a 500-row added_at window their signature cannot scope away - low practical risk, loud failure mode; assumption now documented at the call site and the commit message's blanket scoping claim corrected to name the exception) and 7 lows, chiefly false or overstated claims in the commit message (circular type-first rationale, an index-eligibility statement contradicting the code, a compressed tie-break description, displacement attributed to 5 queries rather than 7, an overstated wrong-typed-library operator note). All resolved by comment-and-message-only edits; mechanically verified zero non-comment lines differ from the reviewed sha 1ece233, and key mutants re-confirmed dead afterwards. Earlier rounds found and fixed: a code comment asserting a false invariant about a conditional type filter, 5 untested dedup keys, a dropped rating DESC tie-break making LIMIT survival plan-dependent, an ordering test passing for the wrong reason, 3 tests depending on a LIMIT window they did not own, and an uncovered catalog-merge predicate. Carried as known follow-ups, not fixed: same-type dedup winner unpinned across all 7 keys (pre-existing for 6), OnboardingGrid's non-total outer sort, and the invariant absent from CLAUDE.md. go build/vet clean; go test ./... green 3x consecutively against Postgres 16+pgvector and clean DB-free.
